description:
Build a scroll-linked image-sequence hero from a video URL, end-to-end.

One call replaces the 5-step recipe: upload video -> submit extract_frames -> poll -> build block -> update page.
Extracts numbered WebP frames from the source video (ffmpeg, ~7x smaller than raw),
uploads them to the client's SpiderMedia bucket with a deterministic pattern
(frame_{0001..NNNN}.webp), then injects a 'sys-scroll-sequence' component block
into the target page AS A DRAFT.

**Never auto-publishes.** After this tool returns, call:
  1. content_deploy_site_preview  (review at preview-{hash}.sites.spideriq.ai)
  2. content_deploy_site_production (with confirm_token)

When to use:
- Agent received "add a scroll-sequence hero from this video" request
- Video is at a public URL (SpiderMedia, di-atomic, or public http/https)
- Target page already exists (use content_create_page first if not)

Frame-count strategies (pick one):
- strategy='target_frames' + target_frames=N  — exact N frames spread across full duration (most common)
- strategy='fps' + fps=N                      — sample at N frames/second
- strategy='duration_fps' + fps + duration_seconds — clip + sample

Returns: manifest {base_url, pattern, count}, the inserted block JSON, and the new draft page version ID.

background_color.description: Hex color painted before frames load (default: #ffffff)

dry_run.description: If true, returns block JSON without touching the page (default: false)

duration_seconds.description: Clip duration in seconds (1-120). Required if strategy=duration_fps

fps.description: Sample FPS (1-60). Required if strategy=fps or duration_fps

output_format.description: Frame format (default: webp — half the bytes of jpeg at same quality)

page_slug.description: Target page slug — MUST already exist. Use content_create_page first if not.

poll_timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for extract_frames (30-900, default: 300)

position.description: Where to insert: "append" (default), "prepend", {index: N}, {before: slug}, or {after: slug}

preload_strategy.description: progressive (default) loads ±15 frame window; all pre-loads everything

project.description: Optional project — a website inside the workspace (proj_xxx) — to scope this call to. Sent as the X-Project-Id header. If omitted, the spideriq.json / SPIDERIQ_PROJECT_ID binding (or the workspace default project) is used.

scroll_distance_vh.description: Viewport heights to scroll through full sequence, 200-800 (default: 400)

target_frames.description: Exact frame count (10-600). Required if strategy=target_frames. Default: 120

video_url.description: Source video URL (SpiderMedia, di-atomic, or public http/https)

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: video_to_scroll_sequence
